Articles

All vignettes

Checking normality and outliers

Check normality and find outliers with rwf: diagnostic plots, eight normality tests, three outlier detection rules, and the formulas behind them.

Recoding and stacking data

Recode data with rwf: stack a list of data frames, reverse-score items, turn multiple-response answers into dummy columns and collapse rare factor levels.

Basic statistical functions

Basic statistics with rwf: Bonferroni and Šidák adjustments, standard scores, skewness, kurtosis, standard errors and confidence intervals, with their formulas.

Training and testing models

Evaluate classification models with rwf: ROC curves, confusion matrices, separability plots, performance at different cut-offs, and k-fold and k-sample cross-validation.

ANOVA

ANOVA with rwf: Kruskal-Wallis, one-way and factorial ANOVA, MANOVA, effect sizes and post hoc comparisons, next to the results of established packages.

ANOVA effect sizes

An ANOVA table with Type I, II or III sums of squares and six effect sizes for every factor, from eta-squared to Cohen’s f, with rwf’s compute_aov_es.

Post hoc comparisons

Compare every pair of group means after a one-way ANOVA with the Tukey-Kramer and Games-Howell tests, with rwf’s compute_posthoc.

Correlation

Correlation with rwf: heatmaps, power analysis, a full report of r, p, confidence intervals and adjusted p, and tetrachoric, polychoric, biserial and polyserial correlations.

Exploratory factor analysis

Exploratory factor analysis with rwf: loadings and scree plots, model loadings, residual statistics and a full EFA report.

Friedman test

The Friedman test, the non-parametric repeated measures ANOVA, with Kendall’s W as its effect size and a bootstrap confidence interval, with rwf’s compute_friedman_test.

Hierarchical linear regression

Hierarchical linear regression with rwf’s report_hlr: add predictors in blocks and see how much more variance each block explains, as the change in R².

Thurstonian item response theory

Thurstonian IRT for forced-choice and ranking questionnaires with rwf: the comparison design, encoding rank data, ability estimation and MAP scoring from a lavaan model.

Unidimensional IRT from scratch

Unidimensional IRT from scratch in base R with rwf: the item response function, item and test information for the 1PL, 2PL and 3PL models, and Newton-Raphson ability estimates.

Item response theory reports

Item response theory reports with rwf: test information and expected score curves, and a full report of a mirt model with its coefficients, local independence and fit.

Kruskal–Wallis test

The Kruskal-Wallis test, the non-parametric one-way ANOVA, with two rank effect sizes and bootstrap confidence intervals, with rwf’s compute_kruskal_wallis_test.

Linear regression

Linear regression with rwf: scatterplots and full reports of simple and multiple regression models.

Logistic regression

Logistic regression with rwf: the logistic function, plots of a fitted model, likelihood-ratio tests of nested models and a full diagnostic report.

t tests and Wilcoxon tests

Pairwise t tests and Wilcoxon tests with rwf’s report_ttests and report_wtests, with effect sizes, confidence intervals and Bonferroni-adjusted significance.

One-way ANOVA

The one-way ANOVA with Fisher’s or Welch’s F test, five effect sizes and the observed power, with rwf’s compute_one_way_test.

Plotting means, interactions and ANOVA diagnostics

Plot group means, interactions and ANOVA diagnostics with rwf, to see what the model found and whether its assumptions hold.

Reliability and validity

Reliability and validity with rwf: Cronbach’s alpha and its item diagnostics, the multitrait-multimethod (MTMM) matrix and Shrout-Fleiss reliability.

Structural equation modeling and CFA

Structural equation modeling and CFA with rwf: path diagrams without semPlot, a full CFA report and a simulation of how model fit changes with sample size.

Natural language processing

Natural language processing with rwf: clean text, remove stopwords, tag parts of speech, compare documents and count words and characters.
